caption:
Advice, or just ears

"Rough day." "Advice or just ears?" "Just ears." She asked first, so she gave the right kind of help.

Asking what kind of help they want saves you from handing out the wrong kind.

For whoever asks whether you want advice or just ears.

Choose friction.
